answer: Locks are published in oasis, expire in juniper, and voyage lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 139 aliases thus needs 137 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2248 identities would post 1165 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
